rule: the recorded rows state how the value was obtained: a benchmark framework, a measurement procedure, a test harness or the code that was timed (pqm4, benchmark, measured, framework, harness, test vectors, KAT, executions, iterations, runs)
evidence_searched: compiler_flags_or_notes, comparability_warning and location_in_source of every cycle row of the source

rule: the recorded rows name a board or chip and a clock frequency: device not blank and not 'not stated', and clock_mhz filled or a MHz value written in the text
the recorded rows state the statistic of the cycle count (mean, average, median, minimum, maximum, single execution, number of executions or iterations)

the source is a code repository or data file, or the recorded rows name a public repository or open source code for the measured implementation (github, gitlab, repository, open source, pqm4, PQClean, liboqs, commit)
the recorded rows name the cycle counter or timer used (DWT, CYCCNT, SysTick, cycle counter, PMU, mcycle, rdcycle, k_cycle_get, timer)
